title: Strongly maximal matchings
exact_target: Does a uniform finite bound on hyperedge size force a matching that cannot be improved by any competing matching, even through infinitely many changes?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 3000084 (AMR-029-0084). CC BY 4.0.
R. Aharoni, Strongly maximal matchings and strongly minimal covers (2022), Definition 1.2 and Conjecture 2.1, pp.1--2.
L. Hollom and B. Randall Shaw, Counterexamples to conjectures on strong maximality and minimality (2025), Introduction, Theorem 1.2, p.2.
